prompts.prompt: Wide natural-light photograph of Fylkingen's brick experimental venue during Stockholms Internationella Downs Syndromfestival, captured from the back of the hall. Environmental photograph of a Stockholm outdoor square near Slussen at the syndromfestival, food stalls, balloon arches, families on blankets, a brass trio playing, late afternoon golden natural light catching white tents and children's jackets.

Extreme close-up natural-light detail of a festival volunteer's hand tying a red ribbon onto a white wristband stack on a folding table, the syndromfestival banner blurred softly behind, sun-warm skin tones, shallow depth.

Intimate candid portrait, soft diffused daylight from a side window: a young performer with Down syndrome resting her chin on her hands backstage at Fylkingen, sequined collar catching the light, quiet proud smile, warm Stockholm afternoon.
